title: Lunar Mare Crater
setting: A powdery moon crater has black basalt shelves, ice beads, and regolith ramps.
food: dust motes → ice beads → rover stones → crater-rim slabs
interaction: Low gravity lets pushed stones coast into shelves, causing slow avalanches that expose routes.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop ice pockets and swallow the basalt lip.
risk: Coasting needs broad boundaries and a steady overhead camera.

title: Dust Devil Basin
setting: A rust-red basin holds soft dust, ribbed dunes, and survey flags.
food: iron grains → pebbles → flag posts → dune hummocks
interaction: A dust column carries grains around the bowl; the goo blocks its edge and diverts the stream into piles.
reveal: Growth makes dune hearts and flag bases edible.
risk: Wind needs a readable loop and stable props.

title: Europa Fracture Shelf
setting: A blue-white ice shelf has cracks, salt ridges, and translucent brine pockets.
food: salt grains → ice chips → brine beads → fracture bridges
interaction: Pushing an ice chip opens a crack; brine flows through and gathers against the goo.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat ice rafts and sealed vents below.
risk: Brine needs local removal that still reads as one surface.

title: Titan Methane Shore
setting: An amber methane shore has hydrocarbon stones, black dunes, and shallow channels.
food: sand grains → hydrocarbon pebbles → buoyant stones → dune islands
interaction: Floating stones follow the current; the goo piles them against a bank to bridge a channel.
reveal: Growth makes the bank edible and lets the goo mop the lake edge.
risk: Buoyancy and grounded goo contact need separate collision tuning.

title: Venus Cloud Deck
setting: A golden cloud deck has puffy layers, mineral balloons, and floating rock shelves.
food: cloud wisps → mineral beads → balloon rocks → cloud islands
interaction: Sliding cloud bands catch beads on shelves and redirect them into slow eddies.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop cloud banks and swallow their support shelves.
risk: Translucent layers must stay readable from above.

title: Io Sulfur Plain
setting: A yellow sulfur plain has dark lava islands, bubbling vents, and ash channels.
food: ash flecks → sulfur pellets → lava pebbles → vent mounds
interaction: Vents pulse pellets outward; a goo wall catches them and pushes the pile into a channel.
reveal: Growth makes vent collars and lava islands edible.
risk: Pulses must read as gentle forces rather than damage.

title: Mercury Terminator Ridge
setting: A sharp terminator ridge has gray regolith, iron flakes, and tilted crater plates.
food: iron flakes → metal pebbles → crater plates → ridge buttresses
interaction: Pushing a plate tips it downhill, sweeping flakes into a basin for collection.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the basin wall and bright iron seams.
risk: Tilted surfaces need collision meshes that let plates slide.

title: Ceres Salt Mine
setting: A chalky Ceres quarry has dark terraces, salt crystals, and briny shafts.
food: regolith grains → salt shards → rubble blocks → mine terraces
interaction: Rubble plugs a shaft; the goo pushes one free, releasing brine that wets nearby crystals.
reveal: Growth makes shaft rims and compacted quarry floor edible.
risk: Use a simple fluid proxy instead of full liquid simulation.

title: Enceladus Plume Fields
setting: A pale ice field sits beneath geysers, snow fans, frozen ridges, and plume beads.
food: frost specks → plume beads → ice fans → geyser collars
interaction: Jets lift beads; the goo nudges their bases, leaning columns that spill frost across the floor.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop snow fans and eat collar ice.
risk: Several jets can clutter the camera without strong color separation.

title: Neptune Ice Plateau
setting: A cobalt plateau has methane-ice ridges, blue boulders, and gust channels.
food: ice dust → blue pebbles → boulders → plateau shelves
interaction: A crosswind accelerates boulders along channels; the goo parks against a ridge and makes a feeding queue.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the ridge cap and hidden shelves.
risk: Wind traffic needs forgiving resets when boulders miss channels.

title: Pluto Nitrogen Glacier
setting: A peach nitrogen glacier has soft flow lines, blue islands, and slow shelves.
food: frost grains → blue chips → glacier blocks → valley shelves
interaction: The glacier creeps around islands; the goo wedges into a flow line and redirects a slab toward chips.
reveal: Growth makes island bases and deep glacier shelves edible.
risk: Slow terrain needs visible accumulation so it does not feel static.

title: Ganymede Magnetic Grooves
setting: A striped ice-rock plain has metallic grains, curved grooves, and magnetic arches.
food: metal filings → iron beads → stone magnets → groove arches
interaction: Magnetic grooves pull beads along curves; the goo blocks one and spills them into a neighboring loop.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat iron arches and their stone anchors.
risk: Moving trails must show the otherwise invisible attraction.

title: Asteroid Rubble Courtyard
setting: A small asteroid courtyard holds loose rubble, anchored boulders, and dust bowls.
food: dust motes → rubble chips → loose boulders → courtyard shelves
interaction: A pushed boulder bumps neighbors into a chain reaction; the cluster rolls into a bowl and gathers debris.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the bowl rim and parent rock.
risk: Sparse piles and broad faces prevent rigid-body jitter.

title: Saturn Ring Gap
setting: A top-down Saturn ring slice has ice chunks, dark gaps, and shepherd moons.
food: ice dust → ring chips → ice boulders → moonlet crumbs
interaction: Shepherd moons nudge chunks into curved lanes; the goo blocks one and builds a debris bank.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the bank and eat shaping moonlet surfaces.
risk: Circular motion needs a strong orientation cue.

title: Ocean Planet Archipelago
setting: A calm ocean planet has shallow water, coral-like islands, and floating ice rafts.
food: foam beads → shell pebbles → ice rafts → island shelves
interaction: A current carries rafts between islands; the goo pushes one sideways to bridge a channel and collect foam.
reveal: Growth makes the raft bed and low island shelves edible.
risk: Depth, buoyancy, and goo contact need clear overhead layering.

title: Super-Earth Canopy Basin
setting: A dense alien canopy has broad leaves, seed pods, mossy soil, and root bridges.
food: pollen flecks → seed pods → fallen leaves → root bridges
interaction: Leaves bend under the goo and spring back, shaking pods onto soil; roots carry them downhill.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop moss mats and swallow thick roots.
risk: Sparse canopy art prevents leaves from hiding edible objects.

title: Lunar Lava Tube
setting: A basalt lava tube has ceiling openings, stalactite rubble, black pools, and low arches.
food: basalt grains → rubble chips → stalactites → arch segments
interaction: Rolling stones strike arches and shed chips; the goo presses under an opening and redirects rubble into a pool.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the pool edge and arch segments.
risk: Cutaway roofs may be needed to keep the player visible.

title: Comet Crust Landing
setting: A lumpy comet crust has frost, crumbly pits, dark stones, and tailward breeze.
food: frost specks → crust chips → dark boulders → pit rims
interaction: Tailward airflow slides chips toward pits; the goo braces on a ridge and turns the flow into a collection line.
reveal: Growth makes pit rims and solid crust bridges edible.
risk: Ridge contact must give purchase against the tailward force.

title: Tidal Ocean Shelves
setting: A shallow alien sea floor has sandstone shelves, tide pools, shells, and kelp mats.
food: foam flecks → shell clumps → kelp mats → sandstone shelves
interaction: A tide pulse fills and drains pools; the goo blocks a channel, leaving shell piles on one bank.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop pool edges and eat shelf lips.
risk: Tides need a calm rhythm, not a timed challenge.

title: Ice Giant Polar Vortex
setting: A turquoise polar vortex has nested cloud rings, ice chunks, and dark storm eyes.
food: cloud wisps → ice grains → storm chunks → vortex shelves
interaction: Concentric winds carry chunks around the eye; the goo slows one ring and bunches chunks against its bank.
reveal: Growth makes the inner storm wall and dense cloud shelves edible.
risk: Distinct wind speeds and transfer points prevent circular repetition.

title: Stellar Nursery Pillars
setting: A pink stellar nursery of towering dust pillars, glowing gas knots, and loose star-forming clumps.
food: dust grains → gas beads → dense clumps → pillar roots
interaction: Gas knots pull nearby beads into slow spirals; the goo nudges a knot aside and makes its gathered trail spill into a pocket.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume pillar roots and the dense clumps hidden behind them.
risk: Soft gas forces need clear particle proxies so ordinary meshes still feel causally connected.

title: Protoplanetary Disk
setting: A young star's flat disk with dusty orbital lanes, ice pebbles, and growing rocky clumps.
food: dust specks → ice pebbles → rock clumps → proto-worlds
interaction: Orbital lanes carry pebbles around the star; the goo blocks a lane and makes a slow traffic jam that feeds neighboring clumps.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the lane ridges and the largest proto-world cores.
risk: Many orbiting objects need capped counts and predictable paths to preserve smooth performance.

title: Binary Star Braid
setting: Two cartoon suns form a bright figure-eight arena with dust ribbons, rock beads, and shared orbit wells.
food: dust flecks → rock beads → clumps → companion-star crumbs
interaction: The two wells braid nearby trajectories; pushing a clump across the crossing swaps its loop and sends smaller beads outward.
reveal: Growth makes the braided dust ribbons and the outer shells of both suns edible.
risk: The figure-eight flow must remain readable when both stars and the goo overlap at the crossing.

title: Red Giant Convection Sea
setting: A red giant surface abstracted as broad orange convection cells, bright bubbles, and dark sinking lanes.
food: glowing grains → plasma bubbles → dark cells → surface arcs
interaction: Convection cells lift bubbles and sink heavier chunks; the goo sits across a cell boundary and redirects the rising stream.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop whole cell surfaces and swallow the arcs separating them.
risk: Animated cell flow can become visually noisy unless each current has a simple broad shape.

title: White Dwarf Crystal Crust
setting: A compact white dwarf crust of pale crystal plates, dense beads, and radial pressure seams.
food: crystal dust → dense beads → plates → pressure ridges
interaction: A pushed plate compresses its neighbors and ejects beads along a seam; the goo catches the beads and redirects their line.
reveal: Growth makes the pressure ridges and the thick plates between seams edible.
risk: The dense material should feel weighty without making every collision slow or hard to tune.

title: Neutron Star Magnetosphere
setting: A dark neutron star surrounded by luminous magnetic arcs, charged grains, and looping field ribbons.
food: charged dust → metal grains → arc beads → field knots
interaction: Field ribbons pull charged grains along loops; the goo crosses a ribbon and diverts the grains into a neighboring arc.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat field knots and the compact star crust beneath the arcs.
risk: Magnetic paths need persistent arrows or trails so their invisible cause stays understandable.

title: Pulsar Lighthouse
setting: A rotating pulsar at the center of a dark arena, with sweeping light blades, rings, and dust beads.
food: dust motes → light beads → orbit rings → lighthouse shells
interaction: Each sweeping light blade pushes beads sideways; the goo parks beside a ring and catches a moving wave of them.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume complete rings and the pulsar's bright outer shell.
risk: Rotation must be continuous and gentle so the scene does not become a reflex timing challenge.

title: Supernova Remnant Shell
setting: An expanding supernova shell made of colorful gas arcs, dust knots, and scattered stellar debris.
food: dust flecks → gas knots → debris stones → shell arcs
interaction: The shell's broad outward flow carries knots toward its rim; the goo plugs a gap and funnels them into a collecting pocket.
reveal: Growth makes the shell arcs and dense debris islands edible.
risk: Expansion should use a compact ring proxy rather than many expensive moving particles.

title: Corona Streamer Garden
setting: A stylized stellar corona of looping streamers, plasma beads, and bright magnetic bridge knots.
food: plasma specks → hot beads → streamer knots → bridge loops
interaction: Streamer currents carry beads along magnetic loops; the goo mops a local section, causing the remaining loop to bow toward a bridge.
reveal: Growth lets the goo swallow bridge loops and the dense streamer roots below.
risk: A translucent loop that disappears locally needs clean end caps and stable joins.

title: Brown Dwarf Storm Bands
setting: A brown dwarf top surface of chocolate-colored cloud bands, pale vortices, and floating mineral pellets.
food: cloud flecks → mineral pellets → storm knots → band shelves
interaction: Neighboring bands shear past each other; the goo bridges two bands and transfers pellets from the faster current to the slower one.
reveal: Growth makes the vortex rims and broad band shelves edible.
risk: Shearing bands require careful seam art so the player sees where transfer can happen.

title: Solar Slingshot Yard
setting: A small star system with a bright sun, looping flyby lanes, icy comets, and rocky moons.
food: frost grains → comet chips → moonlets → orbital shelves
interaction: A close pass around the sun bends a comet's route; the goo nudges its tail, sending the comet through a waiting line of chips.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume moonlet crusts and the broad orbital shelves.
risk: Flyby trajectories need bounded paths so a missed comet remains recoverable and playable.

title: Trojan Cloud Exchange
setting: A star and planet share a broad orbit with two Trojan dust clouds, rocky beads, and stable-looking pockets.
food: dust specks → rock beads → cloud clumps → planet crumbs
interaction: The two pockets trade loose beads along curved lanes; the goo blocks one exit and makes a cloud spill into the opposite pocket.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the pocket rims and the planet's exposed outer crust.
risk: The two exchange lanes need distinct shapes or the pockets will look like duplicate piles.

title: Young Star Accretion Ring
setting: A luminous young star inside a thick accretion ring of dust swirls, gas eddies, and dark clumps.
food: dust grains → gas beads → dark clumps → ring banks
interaction: Viscous-looking eddies pull clumps inward; the goo settles across an eddy and makes its outer stream peel into a side pool.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the side pool and consume the ring banks around it.
risk: The flow can seem decorative unless every eddy visibly moves edible clumps toward the goo.

title: Starspot Archipelago
setting: A glowing star surface dotted with dark magnetic starspots, bright bridges, and convection beads.
food: plasma specks → convection beads → starspot chips → bridge islands
interaction: Surface currents route beads around starspots; the goo blocks a bridge and makes the current pile beads along the dark edge.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat starspot islands and the luminous bridges connecting them.
risk: The bright surface needs restrained bloom so dark edible spots remain visible.

title: Solar Sail Meadow
setting: A calm orbital meadow of reflective sails, dust beads, tethered rocks, and broad sunlight lanes.
food: dust motes → sail scraps → tethered rocks → sail platforms
interaction: Light pressure nudges loose sails across the arena; the goo catches one against a rock, redirecting the sail and its attached scraps.
reveal: Growth lets the goo swallow platform cloth and the rocks anchoring the tethers.
risk: Sail motion needs simple flat collision shapes to avoid snagging on tether geometry.

title: Stellar Wind River
setting: A star's wind portrayed as a wide glowing river with side channels, gas pebbles, and drift banks.
food: wind flecks → gas pebbles → drift clumps → channel banks
interaction: The river carries clumps downstream; the goo plugs a side channel and floods a bank with loose pebbles for collection.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the coherent bank and consume the channel walls beneath it.
risk: A one-way current can reduce exploration unless side channels offer multiple readable entry points.

title: Heliospheric Bow Shock
setting: A curved stellar-wind boundary with layered gas fronts, dust knots, and a quiet protected pocket.
food: gas wisps → dust knots → front clumps → shock arcs
interaction: Incoming wind compresses knots against the curved front; the goo opens a notch, letting the knots roll into the sheltered pocket.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat thick shock arcs and the dense pocket wall.
risk: The boundary needs a clear thickness model so opening a notch feels physical rather than scripted.

title: Collapsing Gas Globes
setting: Several colorful gas globes drift in a stellar nursery, each layered with dust shells and dense cores.
food: dust flecks → gas beads → shell clumps → globe cores
interaction: Neighboring globes tug together; the goo pushes one shell into another, merging their outer gas and exposing a larger shared core.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume merged shells and the dense cores at their contact seam.
risk: Merging volumes need a convincing visual blend without requiring expensive volumetric rendering.

title: Triple-Star Pinwheel
setting: Three small cartoon stars form a pinwheel of orbital lanes, dust petals, and wandering rock clumps.
food: dust grains → rock clumps → orbit petals → star shells
interaction: The three wells exchange clumps between curved lanes; the goo blocks one petal and sends its traffic into the next star's loop.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the petal lanes and the outer shells of all three stars.
risk: Three gravity centers can overwhelm the player unless each lane has a distinct width and color cue.

title: Nova Shell Garden
setting: A fresh nova surrounded by concentric ejecta shells, colorful gas petals, and slowly drifting stellar beads.
food: gas flecks → stellar beads → shell petals → nova rim
interaction: Radial streams carry beads through gaps in each shell; the goo blocks one gap and diverts the stream around a petal.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop entire shell petals and consume the nova's outer rim.
risk: Concentric shells need asymmetric landmarks so navigation does not collapse into repeated circles.

title: Spiral Arm Dust Highway
setting: A top-down spiral arm built from luminous dust lanes, gas clumps, and scattered young stars.
food: dust specks → gas clumps → star knots → arm shelves
interaction: The arm's broad flow carries clumps along curved lanes; the goo parks across one lane and builds a feeding bank.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the lane edges and the star shelves hidden behind them.
risk: The spiral needs a local play boundary so its scale does not make the goal feel distant.

title: Barred Galaxy Crossroads
setting: A barred galaxy reduced to a bright central bar, crossing dust lanes, star beads, and outer arms.
food: dust grains → star beads → lane clumps → bar segments
interaction: The bar funnels clumps toward each end; the goo blocks a junction and redirects the stream into a side arm.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the bar ends and the dense lane segments around the junction.
risk: Crossing flows need strong arrows and spacing to avoid looking like random background motion.

title: Globular Cluster Orchard
setting: A dense spherical star cluster shown as layered golden orbits, star balls, and dark dust pockets.
food: dust motes → star beads → small stars → cluster giants
interaction: Close orbits make star balls bump and exchange lanes; the goo wedges into a gap and catches the displaced outer stars.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat dense orbit bands and the largest cluster stars.
risk: High object density can obscure the goo, requiring a sparse local slice of the cluster.

title: Nebula Pillar Maze
setting: A colorful nebula of gas pillars, translucent cloud pools, dust shelves, and bright ionized knots.
food: gas wisps → dust knots → cloud shelves → pillar roots
interaction: A broad ionized wind pushes cloud pools around pillar bases; the goo mops one pool section and the remainder curls into a side channel.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume pillar roots and the dense shelves behind the clouds.
risk: Cloud transparency and local removal need careful layering to preserve readable corridors.

title: Tidal Bridge Collision
setting: Two stylized spiral galaxies overlap, joined by a bright tidal bridge of stars and dust.
food: dust flecks → star knots → arm clumps → bridge segments
interaction: The rotating discs pull bridge clumps in opposite directions; the goo braces on the bridge and shifts a clump toward the nearer disc.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat bridge segments and the outer arm shelves of each disc.
risk: Two overlapping rotations can be expensive and visually confusing without limited object counts.

title: Dwarf Galaxy Satellite
setting: A small dwarf galaxy circles a larger glowing host, connected by a thin stream of stars.
food: dust beads → dwarf stars → stream knots → satellite shelves
interaction: The host's pull stretches the satellite stream; the goo catches a knot and drags it sideways, thickening a nearby feeder pocket.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the satellite's outer shelf and the stream's dense knots.
risk: The large host must remain a clear backdrop rather than an unreachable destination.

title: Dark Halo Tracer Hills
setting: A galaxy halo shown by glowing tracer beads rolling over invisible gravity hills around a dim disc.
food: tracer specks → halo beads → star clumps → disc rim
interaction: Gravity-inspired slopes bend tracer paths around the disc; the goo blocks a low pass and sends beads up a neighboring hill.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the tracer field and swallow the disc's outer rim.
risk: Invisible terrain needs visible contour ribbons or the cause of each bend will be unclear.

title: Quasar Jet Canyon
setting: A brilliant galactic nucleus sends twin cartoon jets through a canyon of gas knots and star clumps.
food: gas flecks → gas knots → star clumps → jet collars
interaction: The twin jets push clumps down opposite channels; the goo bridges one channel and spills its traffic into the other.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume jet collars and the canyon shelves surrounding the nucleus.
risk: Twin flows must stay gentle and collectible so they feel like moving terrain rather than hazards.

title: Active Nucleus Accretion
setting: A barred galactic nucleus surrounded by a thick accretion ring, star beads, and gas eddies.
food: dust grains → gas beads → star knots → ring banks
interaction: Eddies pull beads toward the center; the goo settles across one eddy and makes its outer stream peel into a feeder pool.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the pool and eat the ring banks that frame it.
risk: The central glow needs restrained bloom so edible material remains visible near the core.

title: Warped Galactic Disc
setting: A galaxy disc bends upward into a stylized saddle, with dust lanes, star beads, and raised rim shelves.
food: dust specks → star beads → lane clumps → warped shelves
interaction: The disc's slope sends beads downhill across the warp; the goo rests on a crease and redirects them along the raised rim.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the crease and the outer shelves holding the disc's bend.
risk: A three-dimensional warp must read from the top camera without relying on hidden depth.

title: Filament Web Junction
setting: Three thick cosmic filaments meet at a glowing knot, carrying galaxies, dust beads, and gas clumps.
food: dust flecks → gas clumps → galaxy beads → filament knots
interaction: Matter streams along each filament and collides at the knot; the goo blocks one branch and diverts its stream into a quieter branch.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat knot walls and the broad filament sections around the junction.
risk: The streams need slow speeds and large pieces to avoid becoming unreadable particle effects.

title: Supercluster Foam
setting: A supercluster abstracted as giant translucent bubble walls, galaxy beads, and slow-moving void pockets.
food: dust motes → galaxy beads → wall knots → bubble walls
interaction: Galaxy beads drift along bubble walls; the goo mops a local wall section and the remaining membrane bows toward a neighboring pocket.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume whole wall knots and open a broad view into the quiet void.
risk: Membrane deformation needs a simple ring mesh or it may become a costly simulation.

title: Galactic Ring Reservoir
setting: A barred galaxy's outer ring filled with dust reservoirs, star clumps, feeder gaps, and shepherd clusters.
food: dust grains → star beads → reservoir clumps → ring arcs
interaction: Shepherd clusters herd clumps around the ring; the goo blocks a feeder gap and diverts the herd into a side reservoir.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the reservoir and consume the ring arcs that form its banks.
risk: A closed ring can feel like a track unless feeder gaps create visible alternate routes.

title: Satellite Matter Stream
setting: A long ribbon of torn satellite matter crosses a sparse galactic backdrop, carrying stars and dust knots.
food: dust specks → star beads → stream knots → satellite cores
interaction: The stream bends around the host galaxy; the goo anchors on a bend and turns passing knots into a broad local pile.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the stream's thick core and the satellite chunks at its far end.
risk: A long ribbon needs a compact camera boundary and visible landmarks to avoid feeling empty.

title: Binary Black Hole Garden
setting: Two dark galactic wells orbit inside a garden of glowing accretion beads, dust arcs, and star clumps.
food: dust flecks → accretion beads → star clumps → orbit arcs
interaction: The binary wells twist nearby arcs; the goo nudges a clump across the midpoint, changing which well gathers its trailing beads.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume orbit arcs and the bright rims around both wells.
risk: The wells must be framed as cartoon gravity sinks without implying a lethal obstacle.

title: Radio Lobe Caverns
setting: Twin radio lobes form soft purple caverns filled with pressure bubbles, gas beads, and central dust knots.
food: gas wisps → pressure bubbles → dust knots → lobe walls
interaction: Bubble pressure pushes beads toward each lobe rim; the goo mops one bubble cluster and the remaining bubbles expand into its space.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat lobe walls and the thick central bridge between them.
risk: Bubble expansion needs visible contact boundaries so local consumption remains believable.

title: Galactic Fountain
setting: A galaxy disc sends colorful gas columns upward into a halo, where droplets arc back toward the rim.
food: gas droplets → halo beads → returning clumps → fountain roots
interaction: Rising columns lift droplets and returning arcs drop them elsewhere; the goo nudges a root sideways and changes the landing pile.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the fountain roots and the thick landing shelves.
risk: Vertical motion must be conveyed with scale and shadows while remaining playable from above.

title: Void Edge Caravan
setting: A sparse void edge with isolated galaxy islands, faint gravity lanes, and drifting intergalactic clumps.
food: dust motes → gas clumps → galaxy beads → island rims
interaction: Gravity lanes pull clumps from one island toward the next; the goo pushes a clump off-lane, making it sweep a new arc of dust.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat island rims and the dense material connecting them.
risk: Sparse scenery can feel unfinished unless each island has a distinct silhouette and route purpose.

title: Stellar Graveyard
setting: A dim galactic graveyard of neutron-star beads, white-dwarf chunks, dust drifts, and quiet orbit lanes.
food: dust flecks → dwarf chunks → neutron beads → graveyard shelves
interaction: Dense remnants tug drifting dust into slow pairings; the goo wedges between two remnants and redirects their shared dust wake.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the orbit shelves and the crust around the largest remnants.
risk: The subdued palette needs luminous outlines so small food remains visible in the dark scene.

title: Cosmic Ray Snowfield
setting: A broad galactic magnetic field drawn as sweeping arcs, charged snow-like grains, and starry islands.
food: charged specks → ray beads → island clumps → magnetic arches
interaction: Field arcs carry grains in looping paths; the goo crosses an arc and transfers the grains into a neighboring loop.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the arc surfaces and swallow the island clumps anchoring them.
risk: Arc crossings need different heights or line styles to prevent route ambiguity from above.

title: Folded Ribbon Valley
setting: A translucent spacetime ribbon folds over itself, making two distant valleys touch at a bright seam.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → ribbon knots → valley fabric
interaction: The goo crosses the seam and exits at the folded valley; eating one local ribbon section pulls the two endpoints farther apart.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume thick folds and the fabric bridges holding the shortcut open.
risk: The seam needs unmistakable entry and exit markers so players understand the spatial shortcut.

title: Causal Cone Courtyard
setting: A courtyard of translucent cone-shaped terraces, drifting matter beads, and broad causal ramps.
food: spark motes → matter beads → cone steps → causal rims
interaction: Pushing a bead down one cone face sends a visible wake toward its widening rim; the goo intercepts the wake and collects the bead trail.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop cone faces and eat the thick rims connecting adjacent terraces.
risk: Cone geometry must stay simple enough for reliable top-down steering and ordinary collision meshes.

title: Gravitational Lens Arcade
setting: A massive central lens bends luminous food lanes around it, hiding distant islands behind curved paths.
food: light specks → matter beads → curved arcs → hidden island rims
interaction: The lens bends each moving bead's route; the goo nudges a bead across an arc and reveals a newly reachable lane behind the lens.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the lens arcs and the distant island rims they expose.
risk: The hidden-route reveal needs strong silhouettes or the lens will read as decoration.

title: Wormhole Mouth Orchard
setting: Two glowing wormhole mouths sit in a soft spacetime floor, connected by edible matter and orbiting knots.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → orbit knots → mouth rims
interaction: Pushing a bead into one mouth makes it emerge from the other; mopping one rim locally makes the paired exit wobble and spill beads.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat both mouth rims and the connected floor between them.
risk: Paired portals need consistent object transfer and clear entry feedback to avoid feeling random.

title: Event Horizon Foam
setting: A black circular horizon is covered by translucent foam, stretched matter beads, and a calm central well.
food: foam bubbles → stretched beads → horizon knots → horizon membrane
interaction: Matter sliding across the horizon elongates into tails; the goo mops a local rim and the remaining foam recoils toward the well.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the horizon membrane and the fabric directly around the well.
risk: The horizon must feel traversable and edible without turning the central well into a damage hazard.

title: Time-Lag Reservoir
setting: A translucent reservoir holds matter beads, mirrored motion trails, and soft causal banks.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → trail knots → reservoir banks
interaction: Every pushed bead leaves a world-made echo that repeats its route later; the goo can collect the original and the echo as they converge.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the reservoir and eat the causal banks shaping the echoes.
risk: Delayed echoes can confuse players unless each trail has a distinct tint and short readable path.

title: Block-Universe Stair
setting: Stacked translucent slabs represent adjacent moments, each carrying matter beads, footprints, and connecting ramps.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → slab chunks → stair landings
interaction: A bead pushed on one slab appears farther along the matching ramp on the next; the goo crosses slabs and gathers both positions.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat slab edges and the ramps that bind the sequence together.
risk: Stacked layers need strong height shading so the player does not confuse overlap with duplication.

title: Light-Cone Canal
setting: Angled translucent canals carry glowing beads through a broad spacetime basin with one-way junctions.
food: light motes → matter beads → canal knots → canal walls
interaction: Each canal only carries objects toward its widening end; the goo pushes a wall section and diverts the current into a neighboring outlet.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop canal interiors and consume the thick walls at their junctions.
risk: One-way flow needs persistent arrows and gentle speeds so it never feels like a timed gate.

title: Geodesic Bowl
setting: A curved spacetime bowl slopes toward a central mass, with orbiting beads, ridged paths, and low shelves.
food: spark grains → matter beads → orbit clumps → bowl shelves
interaction: Objects roll along curved geodesics and circle the mass; the goo sits on a ridge and reroutes a clump into a slower orbit.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume the ridge and the bowl shelves that hold the orbits apart.
risk: The 3D bowl needs collision tuning that preserves smooth goo contact on steep slopes.

title: Expanding Metric Meadow
setting: A translucent elastic meadow stretches between fixed star knots, carrying beads on slowly widening lanes.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → lane knots → elastic fabric
interaction: The fabric expands beneath objects and separates them; the goo anchors beside a knot, bunching nearby beads against its stretched edge.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop the elastic surface and consume the star knots holding it open.
risk: Expansion must stay visible and gentle so it reads as world motion instead of an invisible timer.

title: Contracting Metric Basin
setting: A soft spacetime basin contracts toward a bright center, carrying beads past flexible translucent banks.
food: spark motes → matter beads → bank knots → basin fabric
interaction: The shrinking surface pulls beads inward; the goo presses against a bank and makes the incoming stream curl around its body.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the banks and the contracting fabric around the center.
risk: Contraction needs a bounded center so objects do not vanish beyond the playable floor.

title: Möbius World Loop
setting: A broad one-sided spacetime band twists once, carrying matter beads across an upside-down-looking return path.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → loop knots → band shelves
interaction: Objects crossing the twist return from the opposite side of the band; eating a local segment shortens the loop and shifts its exit.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume twist supports and the remaining band shelves.
risk: The orientation trick needs landmarks that remain recognizable after the band turns.

title: Causal Diamond Nursery
setting: Overlapping diamond-shaped spacetime cells hold paired matter beads, sloped floors, and glowing corner knots.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → corner knots → diamond walls
interaction: Pushing a bead into one corner sends its paired bead toward the opposite corner; the goo blocks a diagonal and gathers both paths.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop diamond floors and eat the corner knots linking neighboring cells.
risk: Paired motion needs clear visual links so cause and consequence do not seem arbitrary.

title: Gravitational Wave Sheet
setting: A thin spacetime sheet carries broad traveling ripples, matter beads, and flexible edge anchors.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → ripple knots → sheet anchors
interaction: A ripple lifts beads along its crest; the goo settles across the crest and dampens that local wave, leaving beads in a new trough.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop ripple sections and swallow the anchors stretching the sheet.
risk: The wave must be a simple traveling mesh deformation to stay stable and affordable.

title: Quantum Foam Shore
setting: A dark shore of bubbling spacetime foam has paired holes, glowing beads, and soft connected rims.
food: spark bubbles → matter beads → foam knots → hole rims
interaction: Each bubble opens a temporary shortcut to its paired hole; the goo mops one rim and the partner hole spills beads onto the shore.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume foam knots and the connected shore fabric around each pair.
risk: Hole pairing must be visually explicit so shortcuts feel causal rather than random teleportation.

title: Branching Timeline Grove
setting: A translucent grove of branching spacetime limbs carries repeated matter beads and shared root knots.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → branch knots → timeline limbs
interaction: A bead crossing a fork leaves matching beads on both limbs; the goo mops one limb and the remaining branch pulls the pair together.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume fork roots and the timeline limbs connecting the grove.
risk: Repeated objects need subtle differences or the branches will look like duplicated props.

title: Singularity Funnel
setting: A wide elastic funnel narrows toward a dark point, with spiral matter streams and raised fabric banks.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → stream clumps → funnel banks
interaction: Spiral streams carry clumps downward; the goo blocks an outer bank and peels a stream into a slower neighboring spiral.
reveal: Growth lets the goo eat the funnel banks and the fabric circling the singular point.
risk: The center needs a clear stopping boundary so the player never loses control at the narrow end.

title: Metric Seam Quilt
setting: A continuous spacetime cloth has stitched seams that bend headings, with beads, folds, and slack edges.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → seam knots → cloth folds
interaction: Crossing a seam turns an object's travel direction; the goo pushes a seam knot and redirects a whole bead stream across the cloth.
reveal: Growth lets the goo mop cloth folds and consume the stitched edges joining them.
risk: Seams can resemble ordinary level borders unless their heading shift is immediate and visible.

title: Universe Horizon Dome
setting: A curved translucent dome holds distant star beads along its rim and a slowly receding central floor.
food: spark motes → star beads → horizon knots → dome fabric
interaction: Expansion slides rim beads inward along the dome; the goo braces on a fold and gathers beads as their paths curve toward it.
reveal: Growth lets the goo consume horizon knots and the dome fabric, opening a starry void beneath.
risk: The curved horizon needs an overhead camera angle that shows depth without shrinking edible targets.

title: The Last Fabric
setting: A giant translucent spacetime sheet has elastic folds, causal currents, star knots, and a dissolving edge.
food: spark flecks → matter beads → star knots → spacetime fabric
interaction: Currents carry knots across connected folds; the goo mops each contacted section, and the remaining sheet pulls together until whole regions disappear.
reveal: Growth finally makes the fabric itself edible, exposing the quiet void beyond the last fold.
risk: The finale needs a readable local-consumption shader and a bounded end state rather than an empty screen.
